name: Acrisure Arena at Greater Palm Springs

bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags up to 14" x 14" x 6" with no more than 2 pockets, or small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5", are allowed.
allowed: One clear bag up to 14" x 14" x 6" with 2 pockets or fewer
Or one small clutch, purse or wallet up to 4.5" x 6.5"
Medical or diaper bags with leadership approval
prohibited: Pepper spray and other self-defense sprays
Cans, glass, coolers and hard-sided containers
bagPolicy.note: All bags are searched. The arena cannot store prohibited items, so they must go back to your vehicle.

parking.note: Book parking through ParkWhiz. Online sales close three hours before the event. Payment on arrival accepts cards, Apple Pay and Google Wallet. Cash is not accepted. Open your pass before arriving because cell service is limited.

rideshare.note: Use the designated rideshare area on the north side of the arena near Classic Club Drive.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Acrisure Arena at Greater Palm Springs varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Use the Accessible Entrance beside the Ticketmaster Box Office for elevator access. Listening devices and sensory kits are available at Guest Services. Request ASL interpretation at guestservices@acrisurearena.com at least 10 business days ahead.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted unless the event explicitly allows it. Ask management about exceptions before leaving.

ticketPickup.title: Ticket Office & Will Call
ticketPickup.body: The Ticketmaster Box Office is at the northeast corner beside the front plaza. It opens on event days at 10 a.m. until about one hour into the event. Bring photo ID for will call. Ticket screenshots are not accepted.

gates.title: Entrances & Doors
gates.body: Main entrances are on the east side. Premium entrances are on the west side. The Accessible Entrance beside the Ticketmaster Box Office has elevator access. Check the event page for concert door times.
